research_question: On historical unsuccessful sub-horizon end cases, does Actor-only reset of the cross-episode counter/KV state causally change early termination behavior under paired target episodes?
hypothesis: H-RESET-EARLYEND: rollover-exposed historical early-stop tasks will show online action/termination differences when the identical valid carry package is cleared at the target-episode boundary.
competing_explanation: H-NO-EARLYEND-EFFECT / H-OTHER: the 001A rollover mechanism may not materially explain premature end, and some early stops may occur before rollover exposure.
reference: EXP-RESET-001A accepted R1 at result commit 2f7864ae2c3a4761932aa4d1fedd6b6d5b3388c6; PI acknowledgement 3e4165122b89d6233ab1f42b2dbc5815ae44d29c.
repeat_or_treatment: One common-random-number paired online run per historically confirmed failed-end case with reconstructable rollover exposure. OFF retains the valid Actor carry package; ON clears Actor counter+KV at the target boundary. Up to four UNEXPOSED negative-control pairs.
unique_variable: Actor episode-boundary state carry retained versus cleared; same pre-boundary carry package, target task, environment initialization, weights, critics, sampling and augmentation RNG.
fixed_conditions: Only cases with success=false, eps_len<600 and confirmed final executed end are eligible
Historical worker-local counter_start must be reconstructed; UNKNOWN excluded from primary causal analysis
Valid carry package required; no fabricated counter with incompatible cache
Actor-only reset package from 001A; critics untouched
Same task/scene/initial state and common random numbers within each pair
No Probe, Stop Gate, Oracle Gate, checkpoint comparison or benchmark-wide run
metrics: OFF/ON failed_end, end_step, success, episode length
p(end), end rank/margin around rollover and executed end
expected_result: Directly determine whether the already-proven rollover mechanism changes premature-end behavior on historical early-stop tasks, without claiming overall SR effect.
falsifying_result: If rollover-exposed paired tasks do not change termination behavior and negative controls behave as expected, H-RESET is downgraded as an explanation of premature end despite remaining a real Actor mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Historical worker assignment/counter reconstruction may be incomplete
A single paired seed per task is a screening result, not a population-rate estimate
Task stochasticity may make historical failure itself non-reproducible
Reset may alter trajectory after rollover without changing end behavior
Premature end may arise from exploration, Actor calibration, sampling, representation/readout or safety optimization instead
stop_conditions: No early-stop case has reconstructable worker-local counter state
Valid carry package cannot be constructed
Common-random-number pairing or task initialization cannot be matched
UNEXPOSED controls diverge before rollover without explained implementation cause
Execution would expand to Probe, Stop Gate, 200-task benchmark or checkpoint comparison
